answer: Tie influence to bonded stake that is slashed on detected fraud. Each identity posts a deposit; honest work climbs a trellis of accruing reputation, while a caught cheat loses its bond outright, a brief comet that burns and is gone. Sybils look smooth as velvet from outside, but minting a thousand means locking real value a thousand times, and one slashing event can wipe a whole cluster's deposits, making mass forgery self-defeating.
